channel.title: News Board
channel.description: A personal daily news briefing: AI labs, tech, finance and Fornebu.
channel.itunes:author: News Board

item.title: Thursday 26 November
item.description: Claude-built Lean proof claims to solve the Riemann Hypothesis and GRH · FCC clears SpaceX to launch up to a million AI satellites · Nvidia shares fall again as S&P puts its rating on downgrade watch · Poundland collapses into administration, 11,000 jobs at risk · New York Times tells photographers not to update to the new Photoshop

item.title: Wednesday 25 November
item.description: US readies new tariffs that would hit China and the EU · US attorney general dodges questions on Nvidia probe as shares fall 7% · Transport minister refuses more funding as Fornebubanen nears 35bn kroner · OpenAI says GPT-6 models can design proteins directly · Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets, cleared of racketeering

item.title: Tuesday 24 November
item.description: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after Trump intervenes · Capita boss quits as shares crash 70% over pension failures · Oslo politicians demand a hearing over Fornebubanen's budget blowout · Anthropic launches Claude Ship to fix and merge its own pull requests · US to blacklist Megaspeed, Nvidia's top Asia buyer, over chip smuggling

item.title: Monday 23 November
item.description: Lutnick resists resignation calls as Congress presses him on Nvidia's China chip leak · Silicon Valley workers worry the AI boom in San Francisco is overheating · South Korea's education minister resigns after AI exam-cheating scandal · NHO urges Norwegian workers to accept smaller pay rises to allow rate cuts · Centrica boss 'hugely concerned' as UK energy bills set to jump

item.title: Sunday 22 November
item.description: Outside mathematicians verify Anthropic's Claude-assisted Riemann proof · UN talks on banning autonomous weapons collapse amid Russian blocking · Bitcoin falls to its lowest price in over two years · Norway's oil fund chief calls Nvidia's Huang scandal 'piquant' · OpenAI details layered defences against AI model distillation attacks

item.title: Saturday 21 November
item.description: Anthropic mathematician claims to have proved the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude · Nasdaq erases its 2026 gains as Anthropic's stock slides on day two · Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on US firms building AI data centers abroad · Nvidia shares fall again as SEC reportedly probes its accounting · GTA 6 racks up $3.8bn in sales on its first day, a new record

item.title: Friday 20 November
item.description: Anthropic closes first day at $1.3tn value after record $81bn IPO · California opens AI chip export probe into Nvidia after Huang's exit · Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent · Google adds an AI chat sidebar to its homepage · Norwegian confirms 5,000 customers had card details leaked

item.title: Thursday 19 November
item.description: Anthropic prices IPO, valuing it at up to $1.5tn ahead of Nasdaq debut · Nvidia halts AI chip sales to China despite White House approval · Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, a cheaper frontier model for coding · UK inflation rises again; typical energy bill to jump £443 a year · Fornebubanen overrun could raise Oslo toll fees, threaten other transit lines

item.title: Wednesday 18 November
item.description: Fornebubanen cost overrun grows to 7.3bn kroner, total now 34.8bn · Nvidia posts bumper Q3 results, board confirms Huang will not return · OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models · Waymo pulls driverless taxis off every US freeway after California ban · US confirms investigation into Megaspeed over Nvidia chip exports to China

item.title: Tuesday 17 November
item.description: California sues OpenAI over its AI agents' Hugging Face hack · Trump, Musk back Jensen Huang's return; Nvidia board reportedly says no · Hackers compromise Optimizely, spread malware via Zoom and GitLab · Norway's trade surplus hits highest level since 2022 · Major US banks hit by outages; Chase says it's a software bug

item.title: Monday 16 November
item.description: Anthropic's IPO roadshow is under way, listing possible this week · Investors sue Intel after 29% stock plunge · ULA's Vulcan rocket fails during its return-to-flight launch · Megaspeed now says Nvidia-linked suspected spy left the firm in 2025 · Construction freeze hits Fornebu, 7,500 homes still to be built

item.title: Sunday 15 November
item.description: SpaceX catches Starship's upper stage for first time, loses booster · Italy fines Meta €805m over access to Android users' photos · Researchers find Lovable AI apps leaking passports, 200,000 chats · Report: Nvidia used financing deals to keep GPU prices high · Google launches Gemini Decisions API for fast AI choices

item.title: Saturday 14 November
item.description: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so its AI agents can make purchases · FAA orders third-ever nationwide ground stop over equipment failure · Huang summoned to testify before Congress as Nvidia fallout widens · Microsoft says Outlook and Teams outage is resolved, not a cyberattack · Jaguar Land Rover posts £451m quarterly loss after cutting 4,000 jobs

item.title: Friday 13 November
item.description: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, Colette Kress named interim · Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, replacing its 3.8 Flash model · Microsoft still fighting to fix global Outlook and Teams outage · UK economy grows at fastest rate in more than two years · Oslo to close most of the metro for four days over Fornebubanen signal system
